definition: A manual intervention is human action needed after the run started to recover or choose the next iteration; the initial task request is excluded.
credential_note: The user entered the NSCC password to open an encrypted reusable control session and rotated an exposed API key; experiment choice/recovery required no human action.
security_action_outside_model_run: The exposed key was revoked and replaced; the rotated key is installed in the mode-600 NSCC secret file and was never printed by the secure configuration path.
